findings.title: DMARC not enforced (p=none): domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud

evidence.excerpt: DMARC record: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@brightwaterfleet.example; policy=none, pct=100, rua=true

findings.deal_impact: Domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud against customers and finance counterparties, creating fraud and insurability risk until DMARC is enforced.

remediation.summary: Move DMARC from p=none to quarantine then reject after monitoring rua reports and aligning SPF/DKIM senders.

findings.title: SPF uses soft/neutral fail

evidence.excerpt: SPF record: v=spf1 include:_spf.mailhost.example include:sendgrid.example ~all; qualifier=~all, lookup_count=2

findings.deal_impact: Soft-fail SPF weakens spoofing resistance and compounds the unenforced DMARC posture for a fleet/finance-heavy business.

remediation.summary: Inventory authorized senders then change SPF ~all to -all in coordination with DMARC enforcement.

findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled
findings.deal_impact: Unsigned DNS increases cache-poisoning/redirection risk; low standalone deal impact but expected by insurers.

remediation.summary: Enable DNSSEC at registrar/DNS provider and verify DS publication and validation.

findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: Risky hostname pattern=vpn, first_seen=2023-02-11, last_seen=2026-09-30; risky_hostnames_count=4

findings.deal_impact: Public admin/legacy/staging names enlarge attack surface and suggest decommissioning and access-control diligence is needed pre-close.

remediation.summary: Validate ownership and exposure of each risky host, remove or restrict legacy/staging systems, and enforce MFA/VPN controls.

findings.title: Large certificate footprint relative to company size

evidence.excerpt: CT query returned unique_hostnames=47, above the >40 rule threshold for a 201-1000 employee company.

findings.deal_impact: A 47-host certificate footprint indicates possible asset sprawl and incomplete inventory, raising diligence and management overhead.

remediation.summary: Reconcile all CT hostnames to an asset inventory, assign owners, and retire unneeded certificates/hosts.

findings.title: Deprecated TLS versions offered

evidence.excerpt: tls_support: TLSv1.0=true, TLSv1.1=true, TLSv1.2=true; tls_versions=[TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2]

findings.deal_impact: Deprecated TLS on www weakens transport security and may fail customer/insurer security reviews.

remediation.summary: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1, retain TLSv1.2+ with modern ciphers, and retest all hosts.

findings.title: HSTS not set
findings.deal_impact: Without HSTS, users can be downgraded to plaintext, undermining portal trust; easy remediation expected by insurers.

remediation.summary: Set Strict-Transport-Security with an appropriate max-age on apex and www after confirming HTTPS-only operation.

findings.title: Internet-facing appliance listed in CISA KEV (version not verified)

evidence.excerpt: KEV match CVE-PLACEHOLDER-0001, ExampleGate SSL-VPN 7.0.11, match_tier=appliance_exposed, match_level=product; note: KEV lists products, not affected versions; version not verified. Snapshot 2026-10-20.
Fingerprint: product=ExampleGate SSL-VPN, version=7.0.11, kind=appliance, source=asset_path on www host.

findings.deal_impact: Potential exposure to a KEV-listed internet-facing appliance (version not verified) could enable initial access; requires urgent patch verification and may affect closing conditions/insurability.

remediation.summary: Immediately verify appliance version and patch level against KEV, patch or isolate the appliance, and review VPN logs for compromise.

findings.title: Publicly disclosed security incident in the last 24 months

evidence.excerpt: State AG breach notice dated 2025-08-14: unauthorized access to a customer support system; approx. 3,100 individuals notified. disclosed_within_months=14, entity_match=exact.

findings.deal_impact: A disclosed incident 14 months ago raises regulatory, notification-cost, and recurrence-risk questions for valuation and reps/warranties.

remediation.summary: Obtain incident report, regulator correspondence, remediation evidence and lessons-learned; confirm notification and monitoring obligations are closed.
